blind.description: A classic wooden bookcase/bookshelf with ornate carved pilasters on both sides and decorative molding at top and bottom. It features four shelves filled with colourful antique books, scrolls, and small wooden boxes, resting atop two lower drawers with ring pulls. Surfaces are clean, continuous, and fully modeled with hand-painted stylized wood and leather/paper textures. The back is a flat solid wooden panel, and the bottom rests flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A rectangular dark brown wooden top with protruding molded cornices on the left and right ends, front, and back.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly taller than the figure, roughly 6 ft tall, and about 3.5 ft wide.
